+// Package billing contains hosted billing and programme contracts.
+package billing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"net/url"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+)
+
+type OSSStatus string
+
+const (
+	OSSSubmitted OSSStatus = "submitted"
+	OSSApproved  OSSStatus = "approved"
+	OSSRejected  OSSStatus = "rejected"
+)
+
+type OSSApplication struct {
+	ID             string
+	InstallationID int64
+	RepositoryID   int64
+	RepositoryURL  string
+	ContactEmail   string
+	Reason         string
+	Status         OSSStatus
+	SubmittedAt    time.Time
+}
+
+type OSSDecision struct {
+	ApplicationID, Actor, Reason string
+	Status                       OSSStatus
+	CreditGrant                  int64
+}
+
+type OSSStore interface {
+	Submit(context.Context, OSSApplication) (OSSApplication, bool, error)
+	// Decide atomically records the audit decision and any approved credit grant.
+	Decide(context.Context, int64, OSSDecision, OSSStatus) (OSSApplication, error)
+}
+
+type OSSProgramme struct {
+	Store           OSSStore
+	ApprovalCredits int64
+}
+
+func (p OSSProgramme) Apply(ctx context.Context, application OSSApplication) (OSSApplication, bool, error) {
+	if p.Store == nil || application.InstallationID <= 0 || application.RepositoryID <= 0 || application.ContactEmail == "" || strings.TrimSpace(application.Reason) == "" || !publicHTTPSRepository(application.RepositoryURL) {
+		return OSSApplication{}, false, errors.New("tenant, public HTTPS repository, contact, reason, and store are required")
+	}
+	application.Status = OSSSubmitted
+	return p.Store.Submit(ctx, application)
+}
+
+func (p OSSProgramme) Decide(ctx context.Context, installationID int64, applicationID, actor string, approve bool, reason string) (OSSApplication, error) {
+	if p.Store == nil || installationID <= 0 || applicationID == "" || actor == "" || strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
+		return OSSApplication{}, errors.New("tenant, application, actor, reason, and store are required")
+	}
+	decision := OSSDecision{ApplicationID: applicationID, Actor: actor, Reason: reason, Status: OSSRejected}
+	if approve {
+		if p.ApprovalCredits <= 0 {
+			return OSSApplication{}, errors.New("positive approval credits are required")
+		}
+		decision.Status, decision.CreditGrant = OSSApproved, p.ApprovalCredits
+	}
+	return p.Store.Decide(ctx, installationID, decision, OSSSubmitted)
+}
+
+func publicHTTPSRepository(raw string) bool {
+	u, err := url.Parse(raw)
+	return err == nil && u.Scheme == "https" && u.Host != "" && u.User == nil && u.Fragment == ""
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f29d81f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/migrations/0013_oss_programme.up.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+BEGIN;
+CREATE TABLE oss_applications (
+    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+    installation_id bigint NOT NULL,
+    repository_id bigint NOT NULL,
+    repository_url text NOT NULL CHECK (repository_url LIKE 'https://%'),
+    contact_email text NOT NULL CHECK (length(contact_email) BETWEEN 3 AND 320),
+    reason text NOT NULL CHECK (length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000),
+    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitted' CHECK (status IN ('submitted', 'approved', 'rejected')),
+    submitted_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+    decided_at timestamptz,
+    decided_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+    decision_reason text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+    credit_grant bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (credit_grant >= 0),
+    FOREIGN KEY (installation_id, repository_id) REFERENCES repositories(installation_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+    CHECK ((status = 'submitted' AND decided_at IS NULL AND decided_by = '') OR (status <> 'submitted' AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND decided_by <> ''))
+);
+ALTER TABLE oss_applications ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE oss_applications FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON oss_applications USING (installation_id = current_setting('px1.installation_id', true)::bigint) WITH CHECK (installation_id = current_setting('px1.installation_id', true)::bigint);
+COMMIT;

explanations.title: Validate and initialize OSS applications
explanations.summary: Applications are rejected unless they include valid tenant and repository IDs, contact details, a nonblank reason, and an HTTPS repository URL without user information or a fragment. Accepted applications are submitted with the `submitted` status.

explanations.title: Record terminal decisions and approval credits
explanations.summary: Decisions require an installation, application, actor, and reason. Approvals additionally require positive configured credits and pass that grant to the store; decisions are requested only against the `submitted` status, with the store contract requiring atomic recording.

explanations.title: Add tenant-scoped OSS application storage
explanations.summary: The new table persists application and decision details, ties each application to a repository in the same installation, constrains statuses and credit grants, and enforces tenant-scoped row access using `px1.installation_id`.
